highlights.title_zh: EEG-FM-Benchmark 修 CLI 布尔坑：70 条复现命令里每条都至少有一个 flag 被静默取反
highlights.title_en: EEG-FM-Benchmark Fixes a Boolean CLI Trap: Every One of 70 Reproduce Commands Had a Flipped Flag
highlights.brief: EEG-FM-Benchmark 合并 #5，修一个非常典型的「能跑但结果不同」的坑：`run_finetuning.py` 的布尔开关用 **`type=bool`**，而 Python 把任何**非空字符串**都当 True，于是 **`--apply_EA False` 实际是开启 EA**。更严重的是影响面——`config/*.json` 里共 **70 条 `reproduce_command`**，走当前解析器时**每条都至少有一个 flag 与它写的值相反**。对基准仓库，这类 bug 直接动摇「别人能否复现我的数」：命令贴出去了、也能跑通，但实际配置不是你标称的那套。修复方式通常是改用 `store_true`/`store_false` 或显式解析字符串。建议所有提供 reproduce 命令的项目都自查一遍同类写法。

highlights.title_zh: 脑控六足机器人：从离线 CCA 到 250 Hz 实时流式闭环（中文，可复现记录）
highlights.title_en: An SSVEP Brain-Controlled Hexapod: From Offline CCA to a 250 Hz Streaming Closed Loop
highlights.brief: 新建仓库（2026-11-12，中文）完整记录了一套**基于 SSVEP 的脑控六足机器人**系统的演进路线：从**离线 CCA 解码**起步，走到 **250 Hz 实时流式**，再到**闭环控制**。这类「从离线到实时」的完整记录很稀缺——多数 SSVEP 项目止步于离线准确率，而真正难的是**实时流式下的延迟、丢帧与刺激时序对齐**，以及把解码结果映射成机器人指令时的安全边界。技术栈写明 Python 3.10 + MNE + scikit-learn，强调可复现。对做 SSVEP 工程化或机器人控制的团队，这是一手参考；采用前建议先核对**刺激频率与 CCA 模板**的对应关系，以及实时环路的端到端延迟。

highlights.title_zh: MNE-Python 深度源建模第二阶段：皮层下网格按表面绘制并随时间/色标联动
highlights.title_en: MNE-Python Deep Source Modeling Phase 2: Subcortical Meshes Drawn as Surfaces With Time Coupling
highlights.brief: MNE-Python 合并 #14450（**深度源建模第二阶段**）：**皮层下网格**现在与皮层一起按**表面**绘制，且颜色**跟随时间滑块与色标上下限**联动。这条解决的是一个很实际的可视化缺口——做深部源（丘脑、基底节、海马）时，过去只能看到皮层上的结果，皮下活动要么孤立显示、要么不随时间轴变化，导致「时间演化」这一关键维度在图上读不出来。PR 里也说明了实现方式（由模型辅助、作者复核并补了示例）。建议升级后跑一遍官方示例，确认配色映射与时间轴行为符合预期，再用于自己的结果图。

items.title_zh: EEG-FM-Benchmark 修 CLI 布尔坑：70 条复现命令里每条都至少有一个 flag 被静默取反
items.title_en: EEG-FM-Benchmark Fixes a Boolean CLI Trap: Every One of 70 Reproduce Commands Had a Flipped Flag
bullets_zh: `run_finetuning.py` 的布尔开关用 `type=bool`，Python 把任何**非空字符串**都当 True，于是 `--apply_EA False` 实际**打开了 EA**。
影响不止用户手输：`config/*.json` 里的 **`reproduce_command` 共 70 条**，走当前解析器时**每条都至少有一个 flag 与预期不符**。
这是「复现命令跑得通、结果却不同」的典型成因；对基准仓库，它直接动摇结论可比性。
bullets_en: Boolean switches in run_finetuning.py used type=bool, and Python treats any non-empty string as True, so --apply_EA False actually turned EA on.
The impact goes beyond manual runs: all 70 reproduce_command entries in config/*.json go through the same parser and every one has at least one flag that does not match its value.
This is a textbook cause of 'the reproduce command runs but results differ', and for a benchmark repo it undermines comparability outright.
items.brief: EEG-FM-Benchmark 合并 #5，修一个非常典型的「能跑但结果不同」的坑：`run_finetuning.py` 的布尔开关用 **`type=bool`**，而 Python 把任何**非空字符串**都当 True，于是 **`--apply_EA False` 实际是开启 EA**。更严重的是影响面——`config/*.json` 里共 **70 条 `reproduce_command`**，走当前解析器时**每条都至少有一个 flag 与它写的值相反**。对基准仓库，这类 bug 直接动摇「别人能否复现我的数」：命令贴出去了、也能跑通，但实际配置不是你标称的那套。修复方式通常是改用 `store_true`/`store_false` 或显式解析字符串。建议所有提供 reproduce 命令的项目都自查一遍同类写法。
items.brief_en: EEG-FM-Benchmark merged #5 fixing a textbook 'runs but differs' bug: boolean switches used type=bool, and Python treats any non-empty string as True, so --apply_EA False turned EA on. Worse, all 70 reproduce_command entries in config/*.json pass through that parser, each with at least one flag opposite to its value. Other projects should audit the same pattern.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #5: "Fix boolean CLI flags: 'False' was parsed as True — There's a small bug in `run_finetuning.py`: the boolean flags use `type=bool`, and Python treats any non-empty string as True. So `--apply_EA False` actually turns EA on. This also affects the `reproduce_command` lines in `config/*.json`. When those 70 commands go through the current parser, every one of them has at least one flag that doesn't match the val[ue]…"
items.why_valuable: 70 条复现命令每条都有 flag 被取反，动摇基准结论的可比性与可复现性。

items.title_zh: 脑控六足机器人：从离线 CCA 到 250 Hz 实时流式闭环（中文，可复现记录）
items.title_en: An SSVEP Brain-Controlled Hexapod: From Offline CCA to a 250 Hz Streaming Closed Loop
bullets_zh: 完整记录一套 **SSVEP-BCI × 六足机器人** 系统的演进：**离线 CCA 解码 → 250 Hz 实时流式 → 闭环控制**。
技术栈明确（Python 3.10、MNE、scikit-learn），强调**可复现**；对做 SSVEP 工程化的团队，这是把「算法」和「机器人控制」真正接起来的一手参考。
自研项目（非论文配套），规模约 5.8 MB；采用前建议核对刺激频率与 CCA 模板的对应关系。
bullets_en: It documents the full evolution of an SSVEP-BCI hexapod system: offline CCA decoding, then 250 Hz real-time streaming, then closed-loop control.
The stack is explicit (Python 3.10, MNE, scikit-learn) and reproducibility is emphasised, making it a hands-on reference for connecting SSVEP decoding to robot control.
A self-built project (not paper code) at about 5.8 MB; verify the mapping between stimulus frequencies and CCA templates before reuse.
items.brief: 新建仓库（2026-11-12，中文）完整记录了一套**基于 SSVEP 的脑控六足机器人**系统的演进路线：从**离线 CCA 解码**起步，走到 **250 Hz 实时流式**，再到**闭环控制**。这类「从离线到实时」的完整记录很稀缺——多数 SSVEP 项目止步于离线准确率，而真正难的是**实时流式下的延迟、丢帧与刺激时序对齐**，以及把解码结果映射成机器人指令时的安全边界。技术栈写明 Python 3.10 + MNE + scikit-learn，强调可复现。对做 SSVEP 工程化或机器人控制的团队，这是一手参考；采用前建议先核对**刺激频率与 CCA 模板**的对应关系，以及实时环路的端到端延迟。
items.brief_en: Created 2026-11-12, this Chinese repo documents an SSVEP brain-controlled hexapod's evolution: offline CCA decoding, then 250 Hz real-time streaming, then closed-loop control. Full records from offline to real-time are rare — most SSVEP projects stop at offline accuracy, while the hard parts are latency, dropped frames and stimulus timing. Verify frequency-to-template mapping first.
items.raw_excerpt: README:「从离线到实时：基于 SSVEP 的脑控六足机器人系统演进」「从离线 CCA 解码到 250 Hz 实时流式闭环，完整记录一个可复现的 SSVEP-BCI × 六足机器人系统。」Badges: Python 3.10、MNE、scikit-learn。
items.why_valuable: 完整走通离线 CCA→250 Hz 实时→闭环，正好补上多数 SSVEP 项目止步的那一段。

items.title_zh: MNE-Python 深度源建模第二阶段：皮层下网格按表面绘制并随时间/色标联动
items.title_en: MNE-Python Deep Source Modeling Phase 2: Subcortical Meshes Drawn as Surfaces With Time Coupling
bullets_zh: #14450：**皮层下网格**现在与皮层一起按表面绘制，颜色**跟随时间滑块与色标上下限**——此前皮层下结构在可视化里是孤立的或不联动。
对深部源（丘脑、基底节、海马）结果的可视化，这解决了「能看到皮层却看不到皮下活动」的实际问题。
PR 说明由模型辅助实现、作者复核并补了示例——这类可视化改动最好自己跑一遍示例确认配色与时间轴。
bullets_en: #14450 draws subcortical meshes as surfaces alongside the cortex, with colours following the time slider and colormap limits; previously deep structures were isolated or unsynchronised.
For deep sources such as thalamus, basal ganglia or hippocampus this addresses the practical gap of seeing cortical but not subcortical activity.
The PR states the model helped implement while the author reviewed and added an example — run that example yourself to confirm colouring and the time axis.
items.brief: MNE-Python 合并 #14450（**深度源建模第二阶段**）：**皮层下网格**现在与皮层一起按**表面**绘制，且颜色**跟随时间滑块与色标上下限**联动。这条解决的是一个很实际的可视化缺口——做深部源（丘脑、基底节、海马）时，过去只能看到皮层上的结果，皮下活动要么孤立显示、要么不随时间轴变化，导致「时间演化」这一关键维度在图上读不出来。PR 里也说明了实现方式（由模型辅助、作者复核并补了示例）。建议升级后跑一遍官方示例，确认配色映射与时间轴行为符合预期，再用于自己的结果图。
items.brief_en: MNE-Python merged #14450, deep source modeling phase 2: subcortical meshes now render as surfaces alongside the cortex with colours driven by the time slider and colormap limits. That closes a visualisation gap for thalamic, basal ganglia or hippocampal sources, where subcortical activity was isolated or static. Model-assisted implementation with author review and an example; run it first.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #14450: "Deep source modeling (phase 2) — Following #14130. Now subcortical meshes are drawn as surfaces next to the cortex, and their colors follow the time slider and the colormap limits. … Opus 5.5 helped implementing, I reviewed, did some modification and added an example."
items.why_valuable: 皮下源活动此前在图上不随时间变化，联动后才读得出时间演化。

items.title_zh: Hillock：给 Claude 的神经工程技能包（30 skills＋6 agents，覆盖解码/EEG-MEG/实时/神经调控）
items.title_en: Hillock: A Neurotech Skill Pack for Claude (30 Skills, 6 Agents) Covering Decoding, EEG/MEG and Rigs
bullets_zh: 定位是把**神经工程的既有工作流**（BCI 解码、EEG/MEG、spike 分析、实时设备、神经调控与器件）打包成 **30 个 skills ＋ 6 个 agents**，供 Claude 直接调用。
卖点是「少查资料、直接给出方法与检查项」，目标是**一致、符合领域惯例**的结果；对新人是上手加速，对熟手是流程标准化。
这类「把领域规范写成 agent 技能」的形态很新，也带来风险：默认值与检查项是否正确，只能靠实际使用验证。
bullets_en: It packages established neural-engineering workflows — BCI decoding, EEG/MEG, spike analysis, real-time rigs, neuromodulation and devices — into 30 skills and 6 agents for Claude.
The pitch is fewer research detours and field-standard methods and checks, speeding up newcomers and standardising practice for experts.
Writing domain practice as agent skills is new, and the risk is real: whether defaults and checks are correct can only be verified by use.
items.brief: 新建仓库 Hillock（2026-11-12）把**神经工程的既有工作流**打包成 Claude 的 **30 个 skills ＋ 6 个 agents**：BCI 解码、EEG/MEG、spike 分析、实时设备、神经调控与神经器件。它的卖点不是「更强模型」，而是**让模型少查资料、直接给出领域惯例的方法与检查项**——对刚入行的人是加速器，对熟手是把流程标准化的手段。形态很新，但风险也明确：**默认值与检查项是否真的符合领域规范，只能靠实际使用来验证**；把它当作「提示出发点的检查清单」而不是「权威判断」，并保留人工复核环节，是更稳妥的用法。
items.brief_en: Created 2026-11-12, Hillock packages established neural-engineering workflows into 30 skills and 6 agents for Claude, covering BCI decoding, EEG/MEG, spike analysis, real-time rigs and neuromodulation. The pitch is field-standard methods and checks. The form is new and the risk clear: whether defaults match practice can only be verified by use, so treat it as a checklist starter.
items.raw_excerpt: README: "Hillock: the neurotech workflow suite for Claude. 30 skills and 6 agents that give Claude the established workflows of neural engineering: BCI decoding, EEG/MEG and spike analysis, real-time rigs, neuromodulation and neural devices. With Hillock loaded, Claude goes straight to the right method, defaults and checks for the task instead of researching what to do…"
items.why_valuable: 把领域惯例写成 agent 技能是新形态，但默认值正确性只能靠使用验证。

items.title_zh: EEGPrep 给远程数据读取加超时：卡住的读取按配置的截止时间中止
items.title_en: EEGPrep Aborts Stalled Remote Reads at the Configured Deadline
bullets_zh: #614：**PyfetchTransport 的读取**现在会在**配置的截止时间**中止，避免网络卡住时整个流水线无限等待。
同批修正「parity-matrix 测试说明」使其与测试一致（文档与实测对齐）。
对批量/远程数据场景，这类超时处理决定流水线是「失败可重试」还是「挂死到天亮」。
bullets_en: #614 makes PyfetchTransport reads abort at the configured deadline, so a stalled network call cannot hang the pipeline indefinitely.
The batch also corrects the parity-matrix test notes so documentation matches the tests.
For batch or remote-data pipelines, timeout handling decides whether a run fails retryably or hangs until morning.
items.brief: EEGPrep 合并 #614：**PyfetchTransport 的远程读取现在会在配置的截止时间中止**，不再无限等待。这条对批量处理很实际——远程数据读取一旦卡住，整条流水线会挂到天荒地老，而日志里往往没有任何错误，只有「一直没进展」；有了截止时间，至少能以可重试的失败形式退出。同批还修正了 parity-matrix 测试说明，使其与实际测试一致（文档漂移同样会误导后来者）。对用 EEGPrep 处理远程或大批量数据的团队，建议把超时值显式写进配置并纳入监控。
items.brief_en: EEGPrep merged #614 so PyfetchTransport reads abort at the configured deadline instead of waiting indefinitely. For batch processing this matters: a stalled remote read hangs the pipeline with no error in the logs, only no progress, while a deadline at least yields a retryable failure. The batch also aligned parity-matrix test notes with the tests. Set and monitor the timeout explicitly.
items.raw_excerpt: Commits 2026-11-12: "Abort stalled PyfetchTransport reads at the configured deadline (#614)" (e8ac94ffb3) 06:32Z; "[docs] Correct parity-matrix test notes to match the tests (#613)" 06:11Z.
items.why_valuable: 远程读取无超时会挂死流水线且日志无错，截止时间让失败可重试。
